source.interpretation: Wallets come from a first-20-buyer alpha dataset; this is an early-entry universe, not a generic rich-wallet leaderboard.

methodology.purpose: Find wallets with repeatable positive results as early buyers before later token expansion.

promotionPolicy.purpose: Promote statistically profitable early-buyer wallets into persistent surveillance. Promotion is surveillance only, never automatic execution.

limitations: The MadeOnSol alpha leaderboard is Solana/Pump.fun early-buyer intelligence, not a universal multichain ranking.
Leaderboard performance is historical and does not guarantee future edge.
The public demo source is delayed and rate-limited; production-grade sub-minute discovery requires a dedicated API key/provider.
Unknown alpha wallets are not assumed to be independent humans merely because exclude_bots=true; insider/sybil risk remains a separate validation layer.

explicitDataGaps: No automatic EVM/Base/Arbitrum discovery in V1; current discovery engine is Solana first-20-buyer focused.
No automatic insider/deployer-link graph yet beyond provider bot filtering.
No guaranteed token-level live trade stream for newly discovered non-KOL wallets using the public demo tier.
Historical alpha score is a surveillance ranking, not a BUY signal.
